app.name: VibeClassAgent
app.tagline: Silent classroom recorder and lesson summarizer

welcome.need_setup: No config yet. Run /doctor fix to create it.

cmd.help_footer: Tip: the same features work as `vca <subcommand>` for scheduled tasks.
cmd.jobs: List every job and its state
cmd.process: Process pending jobs (transcribe → extract → document → push)
cmd.doctor: Environment check; add fix to create missing dirs/config
cmd.paths: Show or change data & config locations (defaults next to the program, never on C:)
cmd.model: Show or pick the extraction model (can fetch the list from the API)
cmd.record: Recording status; record start / stop for manual control
cmd.audio: Probe WASAPI audio endpoints (system sound / microphone)
cmd.record_test: 10-second recording smoke test (with screenshots and muxing)
cmd.transcribe_test: Transcribe the last recording as a smoke test
cmd.e2e: End-to-end: record 15s and run the whole pipeline (documents + push dry run)
cmd.clean: Preview expired cleanup; add run to actually delete
cmd.unknown: Unknown command {cmd}. Type /help for the full list.
cmd.only_commands: This only accepts commands. Type /help, or /status for the current state.
cmd.no_terminal: Cannot start interactive input ({err}). Use subcommands instead: vca --help

status.title: Status
status.jobs_empty: (no jobs yet — recording starts automatically during class hours)
status.stt_missing: model missing, will use cloud if configured
status.llm_missing: not configured, will fall back to raw transcript

paths.title: Locations (from: {source})
paths.restart_note: Restart the program for the change to take effect.
paths.move_note: Note: existing data is NOT moved automatically — copy it yourself.
paths.unwritable_hint: Pick another location, or create the folder first.

model.title: Extraction model
model.pick: Enter a number to pick, or type a model name; empty cancels:
model.need_key: Configure an API key first (env VCA_LLM_API_KEY) and a base_url.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.step_term: [3/5] Term alignment (how odd/even weeks are counted)
setup.step_model: [4/5] Model API (turns the transcript into lesson highlights)
setup.step_push: [5/5] Push channel (sends documents to WeChat / QQ)
setup.step_model_note: Speech-to-text runs locally and needs no key; this configures the highlight extraction API.
setup.ask_base_url: Model service base URL (OpenAI compatible, empty to skip):
setup.ask_api_key: API key (empty to skip; you can also set VCA_LLM_API_KEY later):
setup.key_saved_note: That file holds a secret, is git-ignored, and should not be shared.
setup.key_failed_note: You can set the VCA_LLM_API_KEY environment variable manually.
setup.models_more: … ({n} total; you can also type a model name)
setup.pick_model: Pick a model [1-{n}, enter to skip]:
setup.no_models: the server returned no model list

doctor.title: Environment check
doctor.nothing_to_fix: Directories and config are all in place
doctor.legend: Legend: [SKIP] means it is optional (a fallback exists); [MISS] needs attention.

hint.fetch_deps: Run scripts/fetch-deps.py to fetch runtime components
hint.env_key: Credentials live in environment variables, never in config files
